in_hebrew.name: Farlay
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Farlay הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘far’ meaning ‘journey’ and ‘leah’ meaning ‘wood’, Farlay could be interpreted as ‘traveler in the woods’. This name would be fitting for someone with a nomadic spirit, always on the move, seeking new experiences and adventures.
